'''Giuseppe Resnati''' (born 26 August 1955) is an Italian chemist with interests in [[supramolecular chemistry]] and [[fluorine chemistry]]. He has a particular focus on [[self-assembly]] processes driven by [[halogen bond]]s,<ref>''Halogen Bonding: Fundamentals and Applications'' Metrangolo, P. and Resnati, G. Eds.; 2008; Springer; Berlin, Heidelberg, New York. {{ISBN|978-3-540-74329-3}}</ref> [[chalcogen bond]]s,<ref>G. Resnati et al. ''The Chalcogen Bond in Crystalline Solids: A World Parallel to Halogen Bond'' Accounts of Chemical Research 2019, 52, 1311-1324 (DOI: org/10.1021/acs.accounts.9b00037)</ref> and [[pnictogen bond]]s.<ref>G. Resnati et al. ''Definition of the pnictogen bond (IUPAC Recommendations 2023)'' Pure and Applied Chemistry 2024, 96, 135-145 (DOI: org/10.1515/pac-2020-1002)</ref> His results on the attractive [[non-covalent interaction]]s wherein atoms act as [[electrophile]]s thanks to the anisotropic distribution of the electron density typical for bonded atoms, prompted a systematic rationalization and categorization of many different weak bonds formed by many [[chemical element|elements]] of the p- and d-[[block (periodic table)|blocks]] of the [[periodic table]].<ref>G. Resnati et al. ''Naming Interactions from the Electrophilic Site'' Cryst. Growth & Des.  2014, 96, 135-145 (DOI: org/0.1021/cg5001717)</ref> 

==Education and professional positions==
Resnati was born in [[Monza]], [[Italy]]. He obtained his PhD in Industrial Chemistry at the [[University of Milan]] in 1988 with Prof. Carlo Scolastico and a thesis on asymmetric synthesis via chiral sulfoxides. After a period of activity at the [[Consiglio Nazionale delle Ricerche|Italian National Research Council]], in 2001 he became professor of [[chemistry]] for materials at the [[Politecnico di Milano]]. Since 2025 he is Emeritus Professor<ref>{{Cite web |title=Professori emeriti e onorari |url=https://www.polimi.it/il-politecnico/il-politecnico-nella-storia/i-professori-emeriti}}</ref> of Chemical Bases for Technologies at the same university.

==Research interests==
His research interests cover/have covered the following topics:
* enantioselective synthesis of mono- and polyfluorinated compounds<ref>G. Resnati ''Synthesis of Chiral and Bioactive Fluoroorganic Compounds'' Tetrahedron 1993, 49, 9385-9445 (DOI:10.1016/S00404020(01)80212-X)</ref> and synthesis via perfluorinated reagents (perfluorinated [[oxaziridine]]s as powerful yet selective oxidizing agents)<ref>G. Resnati et al. ''Perfluorinated Oxaziridines: Synthesis and Reactivity'' Chemical Reviews 1996, 96, 1809-1824 (DOI: 10.1021/cr941146h)</ref>
* fluorinated [[contrast agents]] for [[magnetic resonance imaging]]<ref>G. Resnati et al. ''19F Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI): From Design of Materials to Clinical Applications'' Chemical Reviews 2015, 115, 1106−1129 (DOI: org/10.1021/cr500286d)</ref>
* [[intermolecular forces]] and their use in [[crystal engineering]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://iupac.org/project/2016-001-2-300/|title=Resnati coordinated an IUPAC project on crystal engineering}}</ref> [[supramolecular chemistry]],<ref>G. Resnati et al. ''Halogen Bonding in Supramolecular Chemistry'' Angew. Chem. Int. Ed. 2008, 47, 6114-6127 ( DOI: 10.1002/anie.200800128 )</ref> [[Borromean rings]],<ref>G. Resnati et al. ''Halogen bonded Borromean networks by design: topology invariance and metric tuning in a library of multi-component systems'' Chemical Sci. 2017 ( DOI:  10.1039/C6SC04478F )</ref> and [[self-assembly]] processes<ref>G. Resnati et al. ''Halogen Bonding Based Recognition Processes: A World Parallel to Hydrogen Bonding'' Acc. Chem. Res. 2005, 38, 386-395 (DOI: 10.1021/ar0400995 )</ref> in the design and preparation of functional materials<ref>G. Resnati et al. ''An Adaptable and Dynamically Porous Organic Salt Traps Unique Tetrahalide Dianions'' Angew. Chem. Int. Ed. 2013, 52, 13444-13448 ( DOI: 10.1002/anie.201307552 )</ref><ref>G. Resnati et al. ''Halogen-bonding-triggered supramolecular gel formation'' Nature Chem. 2013, 5, 42-47 ( DOI:10.1038/nchem.1496 )</ref>
* [[halogen bond]]<ref>''Halogen Bonding I - Impact on Materials Chemistry and Life Sciences'' Metrangolo P. and Resnati G. Eds.; 2014; Springer; Berlin, Heidelberg, New York. {{ISBN|978-3-319-14056-8}}</ref><ref>''Halogen Bonding II - Impact on Materials Chemistry and Life Sciences'' Metrangolo P. and Resnati G. Eds.; 2015; Springer; Berlin, Heidelberg, New York. {{ISBN|978-3-319-15731-3}}</ref> and [[iodine]] chemistry; [[chalcogen bond]].
* [[green chemistry]]

==Honors and awards==
* ''van der Waals Prize 2021'' (awarded in 2022 by the 2nd International Conference on Noncovalent Interactions, ICNI-2022)<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://icni3.bio.bg.ac.rs/van-der-waals-prize|title=ICNI-2022, The van der Waals Prize}}</ref> 
* ''RSC-SCI Award Lectureship in the Chemical Sciences''<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.rsc.org/images/June%202011_tcm18-204254.pdf|title=RCS News, June 2011, pag. 30: ''RCS-SCI Award to Giuseppe Resnati''}}</ref> (awarded in 2010 by [[Royal Society of Chemistry]]/[[Società Chimica Italiana]])
* ''Intermolecular Interactions and Structural Aspects in Organic Chemistry Award''<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.soc.chim.it/sites/default/files/users/div_organica/Albo%20Premi%20alla%20Ricerca%202014.pdf|title=Intermolecular Interactions and Structural Aspects in Organic Chemistry awards}}</ref> (awarded in 2008 by [[Società Chimica Italiana]])
* ''Corrado Fuortes'' award (awarded in 1986 by [[Istituto Lombardo Accademia di Scienze e Lettere]])
* Invited professor at the [[University of Strasbourg]] (2012, [[Strasbourg]], France)
* Invited professor at the [[Nagoya University]] (2001, [[Nagoya]], Japan)
* Invited professor at the [[Paris-Sud University]] (1996, [[Châtenay-Malabry]], France)
* Senior [[NATO]] Fellowship (1989-1990, [[Clemson University]], [[South Carolina|SC]], USA)
* Member of the [[Academia Europaea]]<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.ae-info.org/ae/User/Resnati_Giuseppe|title=Academy of Europe: Resnati Giuseppe}}</ref> (since 2012)
* Member of the International Advisory Board of the ''Journal of Fluorine Chemistry'' ([[Elsevier]],<ref>{{Cite book |url=http://www.journals.elsevier.com/journal-of-fluorine-chemistry/editorial-board|title=Journal of Fluorine Chemistry: Editorial Board}}</ref> 2001-2023); of ''Crystals'' ([[MDPI]], 2015 onwards); of ''Sustainable Chemistry & Pharmacy'' (Elsevier, 2017-2019)
* Topic Editor of ''[[Crystal Growth & Design]]'' ([[American Chemical Society|ACS]])<ref>{{Cite journal |title=Crystal Growth & Design Around the World in 2012, DOI:10.1021/cg201654d|journal=Crystal Growth & Design|volume=12|pages=1–2|doi=10.1021/cg201654d|year = 2012|last1 = Rogers|first1 = Robin D.|doi-access=free}}</ref> (2012 onwards)
* Member of the International Steering Committee of the: -International Conference on Noncovalent Intereactions (ICNI) from ICNI-1 ([[Lisbon]], [[Portugal]]; 2019) onwards; -[[International Symposium on Fluorine Chemistry|International Symposium on Fluorine Chemistry (ISFC)]] from ISFC-15 ([[Vancouver]], [[Canada]]; 1997) to ISFC-24 ([[Shanghai]], [[China]]; 2024); -International Meeting on Halogen Chemistry (HalChem) from Halchem-V ([[Cagliari]], [[Italy]]; 2010) onwards; -[[European Symposium on Fluorine Chemistry|European Symposium on Fluorine Chemistry (ESFC)]] from ESFC-11 ([[Bled]], [[Slovenia]]; 1995) onwards; -International Symposium on Halogen Bonding (ISXB) from ISXB-1 ([[Porto Cesareo]], [[Lecce]], Italy; 2014) onwards
* Chair of the: -[[International Symposium on Fluorine Chemistry|21st International Symposium on Fluorine Chemistry]] (23-28 August 2015, [[Como]], [[Italy]]); -1st International Symposium on Halogen Bonding (ISXB-1)(18-22 June 2014, Porto Cesareo, Lecce, Italy)<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.rsc.org/events/detail/11194/isxb1-1st-international-symposium-on-halogen-bonding|title=ISXB-1}}</ref>
* Member of the National Organizing Committee of the 6th [[International Conference on Green Chemistry|International IUPAC Conference on Green Chemistry]] (4-8 September 2016, [[Venice]], Italy); member of the International Scientific Committee of the 2nd Green & Sustainable Chemistry Conference, 14–17 May 2017, [[Berlin]], [[Germany]]; member of the Committee of the Faraday Discussion "Halogen Bonding in Supramolecular and Solid State Chemistry", 10–12 July 2017, [[Ottawa]], [[Canada]]<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.rsc.org/events/detail/20585/halogen-bonding-in-supramolecular-and-solid-state-chemistry-faraday-discussion|title=Official Web-site of the Faraday Discussion}}</ref>
* Coordinator of the [[UNESCO]] UNITWIN Network “GREENOMIcS - Green Chemistry Excellence from the Baltic See to the Mediterranean See and Beyond” (2017–2021)
* President of the [[Rotary International|Rotary]] Club Rozzano Parco Sud in the rotarian year 2006-'07; assistant of the Governor of the District 2050 (south [[Lombardy]]) from 2009 to 2013; advisor of District 2050 Governor for starting Rotary Club [[Morimondo Abbey|Morimondo Abbazia]] (2012), Club charter member (2013) and president (2015–16)<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://rcmorimondoabbazia.wordpress.com/|title=Rotary Club Morimondo Abbazia}}</ref>
* Knight of Magistral Grace of the [[Sovereign Military Order of Malta]] (2022)<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.ordinedimaltaitalia.org/sites/malta/malta/files/article/files/orma_marzo_22.pdf|title=L'Orma, anno XL, N.1, Marzo 2022}}</ref>
* Knight Commander with Star of the [[Order of the Holy Sepulchre (Catholic)|Equestrian Order of the Holy Sepulchre of Jerusalem]] (2025)<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.vatican.va/roman_curia/institutions_connected/oessh/index_en.htm|title=Order of the Holy Sepulchre of Jerusalem}}</ref>
* Knight of Merit with Silver Star of the [[Sacred Military Constantinian Order of Saint George]] (2020);<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.ordinecostantinianoitalia.org/lombardia|title=Sacred Military Constantinian Order of Saint George (Spain)}}</ref> Grand Officer of the [[Order of Saints Maurice and Lazarus]] (2022); Knight of the [[Order of Prince Danilo I]] (2022).
